# Pin Slenderness

Height of a pin compared with its diameter: tall thin pins wobble and snap.

<figure markdown="span">
![Pin Slenderness: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-pin-slenderness-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Pin Slenderness: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-pin-slenderness-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Height of a pin compared with its diameter.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [FDM](../../reference/processes/fdm-3d-printing.md) | Medium |
| [Resin 3D Printing (SLA)](../../reference/processes/resin-3d-printing.md) | Medium |
| [Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)](../../reference/processes/powder-bed-fusion.md) | Medium |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At most** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

=== "FDM"

    Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At most | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 10× its diameter | 20× its diameter | Engineering judgement, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "No source gives an FDM figure; resin prints about 20 diameters (Formlabs)") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, PLA-CF (Carbon Fiber), PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU (Flexible), PA, PA-CF (Carbon Fiber), PC.


=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At most | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 10× its diameter | 20× its diameter | Aim for: Engineering judgement<br>At most: Derived, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "0.3 mm wires print 7 mm tall, 1.5 mm ones 30 mm: about 20 diameters") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: Standard Resin, Tough / Durable Resin, Flexible / Elastic Resin.


=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At most | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 10× its diameter | 20× its diameter | Engineering judgement, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Formlabs' resin wire figures, about 20 diameters") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PA12 (SLS), PA12 (MJF), PA11, PA12 Carbon-filled, TPU.


## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

=== "FDM"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Tall thin pin (`{measured}` its diameter): `{feature}` is `{size}`, taller than the recommended `{target}` its diameter. The nozzle pushes a thin pin about as it prints, so it comes out wavy and weak. Thicken or shorten it, or print it lying down.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Pin too slender (`{measured}` its diameter): `{feature}` is `{size}`, past `{limit}` its diameter. It will likely break off while printing or snap in use. Thicken it, print it lying down, or press in a metal pin.

=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Tall thin pin (`{measured}` its diameter): `{feature}` is `{size}`, taller than the recommended `{target}` its diameter. Thin pins wave as they print. Thicken or shorten it.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Pin too slender (`{measured}` its diameter): `{feature}` is `{size}`, past `{limit}` its diameter. It will print wavy and break easily. Thicken or shorten it.

=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Tall thin pin (`{measured}` its diameter): `{feature}` is `{size}`, taller than the recommended `{target}` its diameter. Long thin pins warp and break off during depowdering. Thicken, shorten or brace it.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Pin too slender (`{measured}` its diameter): `{feature}` is `{size}`, past `{limit}` its diameter. It will likely warp or break off. Thicken, shorten or brace it.

| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At most" value |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
